American National Bank decreased Apple Computer Inc (AAPL) stake by 7.81% reported in 2018Q1 SEC filing. American National Bank sold 3,496 shares as Apple Computer Inc (AAPL)’s stock rose 5.37%. The American National Bank holds 41,246 shares with $6.92 million value, down from 44,742 last quarter. Apple Computer Inc now has $923.56 billion valuation. The stock decreased 0.36% or $0.68 during the last trading session, reaching $187.9. About 19.51 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending.
